_core: Answered by core's decision engine, not a writing model (docs/roadmap/jev.md J4). Three choice questions over state = the form's name and its answers: spam (spam, genuine), category (each category's key -> its name and description, plus none; not asked when no category is sent, and then answered none at confidence 1), urgency (low, normal, high, urgent). Every answer is {answer, confidence}, the Decide step's shape, so a product can put it in a run's variables. With no engine configured the tool is not configured (503); it never runs on another model.
